value.rationale: The nonbalanced two-run family is a minimal tractable periodic model for tortoise-factor complexity outside the published balanced Christoffel class. An exact image count for all lengths plus the complete unique double-fiber classification supplies a natural calibration for studies of sorting-induced factor collisions and a sharp injectivity threshold, not just a trivial one-point observation. No higher-iteration claim is made.
